intro: Long-term structural theses as of June 29, 2026 (Monday morning). The defining development: Micron Q3 FY2026 +15.7% revenue beat (after June 26 close) is the most powerful HBM supercycle validation of the 2026 cycle at the US-listed tier — HBM4 sold out through 2026, $50B Q4 guide confirmed, +40% above prior consensus. Combined with the Samsung Blue House $226B AI data center confirmation (June 29 KST, despite the total package magnitude disappointing at ₩800T vs. ₩1,000T expected), these two events constitute simultaneous demand validation from two independent institutional sources: US-listed semiconductor earnings and Korean national-government AI capex. Together they make the Morningstar supply-glut thesis (AI memory revenue peaks 2028, halves by 2030) categorically untenable. The Samsung sell-the-news (KOSPI −3.4%, recovered −0.2%; SK Hynix entry conditions failed) is a short-term tactical disappointment that does not alter any long-term structural thesis in this file. Near-term regime gates still breached (SPX futures ~7,450 approaching 7,460; VIX ~18.10; DXY 101.33; BTC Day 7 active) but SPX is within 10 pts of clearance — best position since May 14. The Micron +15.7% earnings beat is the single most important new data point for all AI semiconductor long-term theses.

ideas.name: Micron Technology
ideas.idea: UPGRADED to HIGH conviction on Micron Q3 FY2026 +15.7% revenue beat — the most powerful earnings validation of the HBM supercycle thesis in 2026. Micron is the US-listed HBM supercycle proxy and the only domestically headquartered HBM supplier. Q3 beat +15.7% above consensus. Q4 FY2026 revenue guide $50B confirmed (40%+ above prior consensus). HBM3E and HBM4 capacity sold out through 2026. Samsung $226B AI data centers ($330B Samsung total Blue House commitment) is the most powerful external demand confirmation of Micron's $50B Q4 guide — at current HBM pricing, $226B in AI data centers implies multi-year HBM demand that extends the sold-out supply cycle well beyond 2026. Russell Growth reclassification June 26 permanently adds Micron to the passive Growth channel ($2T+ in Growth ETF demand).
ideas.driver: Q3 FY2026 +15.7% beat confirms HBM demand is real and accelerating; Samsung $226B AI data centers is the demand validation of the Q4 $50B guide at national-government scale; HBM4 mass production 2H 2026; Q4 FY2026 earnings (September 2026, confirming $50B guide); DRAM pricing inflection (tight supply + AI PC + inference demand); CHIPS Act Idaho fab expansion; SK Hynix ADR $29.4B (BofA/Goldman/Citigroup/JPMorgan diligence confirms multi-year HBM demand); two simultaneous demand validations (Micron Q3 + Samsung AI capex) eliminate the supply-glut counterargument.
ideas.risk: Samsung semiconductor plant ($194B Honam) includes DRAM competition that undercuts Micron pricing; Samsung DRAM price-cuts aggressively to regain share; US-China trade war escalation reduces hyperscaler spending on HBM; memory downcycle triggered by hyperscaler inventory digestion 2027–2028; Morningstar supply-glut thesis gains consensus despite Micron Q3 earnings counter-evidence.

ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.idea: NVIDIA is the dominant AI infrastructure platform for the 2020s decade. The near-term Stop Day 2 framework (June 29 close above/below $195) does not change the 2–4 year structural thesis — it creates the entry discipline for optimal long-term positioning. Samsung Blue House $226B AI data centers (confirmed June 29 despite magnitude gap) is the most powerful demand-side validation of NVDA's long-term TAM at a single corporate event since the supply shortage was identified. Micron Q3 +15.7% (HBM4 sold out through 2026) validates the demand ecosystem that requires NVDA silicon.
ideas.driver: Samsung $226B AI data center buildout over 10 years (2026–2034/35) — at current GPU cluster pricing, implies 40,000–80,000+ NVDA B200/B300/Vera Rubin GPU clusters; Vera Rubin (H3) and H4/H5 GPU architecture cycles (2027–2029); NIM/NEMO software platform attach rate increasing; inference silicon demand expanding beyond training; sovereign AI infrastructure spending (India, Japan, Korea-Blue House, Saudi Arabia, UAE); Q2 FY27 earnings (~Aug 26, $91B guide); Micron +15.7% + Samsung $226B AI capex = entire demand-supply ecosystem simultaneously validated.
ideas.risk: US export control expansion cutting Chinese revenue (~15% of total); AMD MI400 series gaining meaningful inference share; custom silicon (GOOGL TPU v5, AMZN Trainium3, MSFT Maia 2) displacing NVDA for specific hyperscaler workloads; Samsung's own AI chip development ($194B semiconductor plants) eventually targeting NVDA's datacenter market; CUDA monopoly regulatory action; Stop Day 2 triggers on June 29 close (tactical exit, not thesis change).

ideas.name: SK Hynix Inc.
ideas.idea: SK Hynix is the structural winner of the HBM3E/HBM4/HBM4E cycle. The June 29 sell-the-news (Samsung Blue House ₩800T vs. ₩1,000T expected; SK Hynix fell to ₩2,624,000; entry conditions failed) is a tactical disappointment, not a structural thesis change. Three structural pillars remain intact: (1) Samsung $226B AI data centers confirmed — the demand validation of HBM4 at Korean national-government scale; (2) ADR Nasdaq July 10 ($29.4B, underwriters BofA/Goldman/Citigroup/JPMorgan) — permanent US institutional demand channel; (3) HBM4E sole-source for NVIDIA Vera Rubin — structural revenue concentration. Micron Q3 +15.7% independently validates the HBM supercycle from the US-listed tier. Stop ₩2,540,000 (two consecutive KST daily closes below = exit) is the tactical risk management gate that governs this structural position.
ideas.driver: Blue House June 29 Samsung $226B AI data centers (demand validation at national scale despite magnitude gap); ADR Nasdaq July 10 — permanent US passive fund demand; HBM4E sole-source qualification for NVIDIA B300/Vera Rubin+ platform; Q2 KST earnings July 29 (first HBM4E revenue recognition); DRAM pricing recovery cycle 2027; Micron Q3 +15.7% validates the HBM demand thesis independently; stop ₩2,540,000 governs tactical sizing.
ideas.risk: Stop ₩2,540,000 triggered (two consecutive KST closes below) before structural recovery — tactical exit forces; Samsung semiconductor plant ($194B Honam) includes competing HBM4E production undermining 58% market share premium; ADR pricing disappointment (pricing below implied KRX equivalent); NFP July 2 hot print into holiday gap tests stop before underwriter ADR pricing completes; FSS additional regulatory actions beyond weekly options postponement.

ideas.name: Microsoft Corporation
ideas.idea: Microsoft Azure is the enterprise AI moat for the decade. Samsung Blue House June 29 ($226B AI data centers at national-government scale, confirmed despite magnitude gap) re-rates the global AI infrastructure TAM upward — Samsung's AI data centers are computing demand BEYOND what Azure and US hyperscalers are already building; this incremental $226B validates that global AI compute demand is larger than current consensus estimates, directly expanding MSFT's long-term AI revenue potential. Micron +15.7% validates the AI infrastructure demand expansion that underpins MSFT's $50B+ Azure AI capex investment thesis.
ideas.driver: Samsung $226B AI data centers re-rates global AI TAM; Azure AI revenue overtaking GCP for AI workloads (2027); Copilot 365 attach rate inflecting >20% of M365 base; AGI timeline acceleration benefits OpenAI exclusivity; GitHub Copilot enterprise expansion (1.4M+ paid seats, 50%+ YoY); Xbox Game Pass + AI gaming; Micron Q3 +15.7% validates AI infrastructure demand expansion underpinning Azure AI capex.
ideas.risk: OpenAI relationship deteriorates or exclusivity ends early; GOOGL Workspace + Gemini gains enterprise share faster than MSFT Copilot; antitrust action on Azure bundling; Samsung builds Azure-competitive AI cloud platform with $226B data center commitment; AI capex creates cost overruns compressing Azure margins; regime gates remain breached preventing near-term add.

ideas.name: Meta Platforms Inc.
ideas.idea: Meta is the cheapest full-stack AI company on a PEG basis among large-cap tech. The Qualcomm Dragonfly AI inference chip (META as anchor customer) is a structural hedge against NVIDIA dependency not yet priced. Samsung $226B AI data centers (confirmed June 29) creates the AI compute demand context that benefits Meta's advertising AI: more compute = more AI ad targeting optimization = higher CPM growth for META's $160B+ annual ad revenue. Micron +15.7% validates the AI infrastructure demand expansion that makes Meta's AI training investments a structural competitive advantage, not speculative.
ideas.driver: Llama 4 enterprise API adoption; WhatsApp Business AI agent platform reaching commercial scale; Qualcomm Dragonfly AI inference reducing NVIDIA dependency; Quest/AR glasses reaching consumer mainstream 2027; advertising AI (AI Creative Studio, Advantage+) driving CPM growth above inflation; Samsung AI data center demand context validates Meta's AI compute investment thesis; Micron +15.7% validates AI infrastructure demand expansion benefiting Meta's AI ad optimization.
ideas.risk: EU Digital Markets Act (DMA) compliance creating structural European advertising disadvantage; FTC breakup action (spin off Instagram/WhatsApp); Reality Labs losses don't decelerate to breakeven by 2027; Llama 4 open-source enables competitors to commoditize META's AI advantage; regime gates remain breached preventing near-term add.

ideas.name: Procure Space ETF
ideas.idea: STEP ASIDE near-term (through July 7–10 bond distribution clearance + Nasdaq 100 inclusion). Long-term: SPCX is the most concentrated public access to the commercial space economy. Samsung Blue House $226B AI data centers (confirmed June 29) creates the demand context for SpaceX Starlink (AI satellite connectivity for edge AI data centers globally) and Starshield (DoD AI infrastructure at sovereign scale). The $89B demand for $25B SpaceX bonds confirms the institutional valuation thesis at $500B+ implied enterprise value. Micron +15.7% validates AI infrastructure demand acceleration — SpaceX Starlink (satellite AI connectivity) and Starshield (AI military infrastructure) are the next-layer beneficiaries of the same AI compute buildout.
ideas.driver: Samsung $226B AI data centers creates Starlink/Starshield AI connectivity demand thesis for September 2 first earnings; Micron +15.7% validates AI infrastructure demand expansion that drives Starlink edge connectivity demand; Nasdaq 100 inclusion July 7 ($4.3B passive) creates the second permanent passive demand channel in 12 days; SpaceX IPO speculation (2027–2028 base case, $500B+ implied); Starship reaching full commercial operations; September 2 first earnings (Starlink ARR, Starship revenue, Cursor AI $500M+, Starshield); bond distribution clearance July 7–10 (10–12 business days from June 26 settlement); December 9 lock-up expiry (float expansion before September 2 earnings anchor).
ideas.risk: Bond distribution mechanics persist beyond July 10 (Samsung sell-the-news removes X-factor that could have accelerated clearance); Starship development setback; SpaceX decides against IPO indefinitely; $150 IG floor closes below on consecutive sessions — forces lower re-entry; Samsung sell-the-news on June 29 reduces SPCX near-term risk-on support for distribution normalization; December 9 lock-up expiry creates 9–14% float expansion before September 2 earnings anchor.

ideas.name: Bitcoin / US Dollar
ideas.idea: Structural digital gold thesis intact — re-entry framework governs tactical timing. BTC at $60,087 (11:30 UTC June 29) with Day 7 exit gate active and re-entry clock inactive. Fear & Greed at 12 (Extreme Fear deepening) — historically the strongest contrarian accumulation signal of the cycle, but does not override the two-close-$62,000 re-entry gate. Samsung sell-the-news failed to generate the cross-asset risk-on rally toward $62,000 the June 28 framework anticipated. Long-term target: $120,000–$180,000 on the post-halving supply/demand cycle.
ideas.driver: Post-halving supply shock (April 2024 halving cut block reward from 6.25 to 3.125 BTC — ~$5B/year new supply removed at current prices); BlackRock IBIT, Fidelity FBTC, ARK 21Shares collectively absorbed 3–5x daily new supply since January 2024; Fear & Greed 12 has historically preceded 15–30% recoveries within 10–20 sessions; US Strategic BTC Reserve legislation gaining Congressional support; spot BTC ETF net inflows resuming after risk-off period clears; Samsung $226B AI data centers is a long-term risk-on context that supports eventual BTC recovery once the re-entry gate activates.
ideas.risk: BTC drops below $58,100 (June 25 session low) before re-entry clock activates — breach activates $57,500 structural target; Samsung sell-the-news removes the primary cross-asset risk-on catalyst without a substitute; NVDA stop Day 2 triggers on June 29 close creating risk-off contagion below $59,000; regulatory action (SEC, CFTC, G7 coordinated); Mt. Gox final distribution creating sustained selling; NFP July 2 hot print into 3-day holiday gap forces BTC below $58,100 structural level.
